name: web-reader
description: A web-based reader for ebooks in multiple formats.

paragraphs: This project is a web reader built by NYPL for reading eBooks. It was designed using the Readium Architecture, and specifically built for Webpubs. Webpub is a spec defined by the Readium Foundation to provide a common abstraction between many types of web publications. This project currently focuses on HTML-based Webpubs and Webpubs that define PDF collections. An HTML-based Webpub can be generated from many types of eBooks, but most commonly ePubs.
features: [x] HTML-based webpub support (for EPUB, MOBI, etc formats)
